messages:

Subject: Follow-up from today — region pinning + PII questions

Hi Priya / Ben,

Thanks for the call this morning — that was helpful. I promised to capture the follow-ups from our side so the Security and Ops teams can validate alignment. High-level asks from Carewell:

- We need to confirm whether we can require all production inference data (prompts & responses) for the Carewell production tenant to be pinned to a single geography (US-only) with failover to EU only as an emergency cold backup.
- Clarify default and configurable log retention windows (requesting both inference logs & audit trails).
- Confirm whether PII appearing in prompts can be configured to never be persisted to disk or long-term stores.
- Technical details on cross-region backup: is KV cache state replicated cross-region? Are backups encrypted with a customer-managed key?

Attached a simple data map for Carewell (what we send today) so you can map examples to retention options.

[Attachment: carewell-data-map.xlsx (xlsx, 46 KB)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@carewell.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — region pinning + PII questions

Thanks Lena — appreciated the clear summary and the data map. I pulled together answers below, plus next steps and a proposed M.A.P. (mutual action plan) to keep Security and Procurement moving.

Summary answers (short form):
- Region anchoring: Yes — Redwood supports customer-level primary region pinning (you can pin the Carewell tenant to US-East as primary). Failover options: warm-standby in EU-West (for reduced RTO) or cold backup. In your "US-only with EU cold backup" scenario we can implement a cold backup policy where customer data is not actively replicated to EU except during an orchestrated failover.
- Log retention: By default hosted logs are retained 30 days. We offer configurable retention windows down to "session-only" (ephemeral logs cleared after request completes) or custom retention up to 24 months for audit purposes. Audit logs (control-plane events) can be retained for longer per contract.
- PII persistence: We support a "no-persist" prompt mode where prompts & generated content are not written to disk or long-term object stores; transient in-memory processing still occurs for inference. For customers requiring stricter controls we offer a Private deployment where no copies leave the VPC.
- KV cache & backups: KV caches are by default local to the serving region to minimize cross-region leakage. Replication to a secondary region is opt-in and performed via encrypted snapshots. Snapshots and backups can be encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS) when requested.
- Encryption & keys: All data in transit is TLS 1.2+ and at-rest encryption uses AES-256. We integrate with customer KMS providers; HSM-backed key policies are available for Private deployments and can be discussed for Dedicated.

Attachments and docs: I'm attaching a short region-options PDF that maps modes (primary-only, warm-standby, cold-backup) to typical SLA/RTO tradeoffs.

[Attachment: redwood-region-options.pdf (pdf, 112 KB)]

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — high level:
1) This week: provide written answers + region options (this email).
2) By 2026-10-12: Security to send any outstanding questionnaire items we should answer (we can respond within 3 business days).
3) By 2026-10-19: Schedule technical session with Carewell Ops + Redwood Security (30–45m).
4) Procurement/Legal: exchange DPA + proposed redlines (we can accept Carewell DPA with standard data residency appendix).

Can you confirm target retention windows Security needs and if you require KMS/HSM for snapshot encryption? Also please share a few slots for the call — we have availability on Tue/Thu mornings PST.

I'll loop Ben on procurement and Aisha (Security eng) for the technical session.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@carewell.health>

Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@carewell.health>, Carewell Security <security@carewell.health>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — region pinning + PII questions

Priya,

Thanks for the detailed note — that already helps. A couple of follow-ups from Security after reviewing your summary:

- We need clarification that "no-persist" mode truly prevents any disk writes and that ephemeral logs cannot be reconstructed from control-plane traces. Is "no-persist" available on hosted or only on Private?
- For the cold backup option: is there a documented playbook for failover events that includes how you will bring data into the EU backup and timeline expectations?
- KMS: Carewell requires customer-managed encryption keys for any backups that leave our primary region. Can you confirm the KMS providers you integrate with and whether you support BYOK import to an HSM?
- Audit logs: we will likely request a 3-year retention for control-plane audit trails — is that feasible as a contract addon?

Also, for procurement: we need a short blurb that we can attach to the DPA stating that Redwood supports region pinning with configurable failover modes and KMS-backed snapshot encryption. Can you put that in writing so Legal can attach it?

Finally, would Tuesday 2026-10-13 09:00–09:45 PST work for a joint tech+security session?

Thanks,
Tom Briggs
Director, IT Security
Carewell Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@carewell.health>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@carewell.health>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — region pinning + PII questions

Tom / Lena — quick confirmation and next steps below (so you have language for Legal + Procurement).

Short contractual blurb for DPA (editable):
"Redwood Inference will operate the Carewell production tenant with primary data residency anchored in the agreed region (US-East). Cross-region replication is performed only under the agreed failover policy: warm-standby replication (if enabled) or cold backup snapshots (if cold mode selected). All backups and snapshots that move outside the primary region will be encrypted in transit and at rest using AES-256; Redwood supports customer-managed key (BYOK) integrations for snapshot encryption. For customers requiring no retention, Redwood provides a 'no-persist' processing mode that avoids writing inference request/response data to long-term storage; such mode is available on hosted plans with contractual terms or as part of a Private deployment with additional isolation guarantees."

Answers to the Security questions: 
- No-persist: Available on hosted under a contractual configuration that disables long-term logging; ephemeral in-memory processing still occurs. We can provide a short attestation for Legal. For the strictest control we recommend Private deployment (VPC) where no data leaves customer network unless explicitly configured.
- Failover playbook: We have a documented runbook that lays out roles, triggers, expected timelines for cold vs warm failover; we will share an editable copy during the technical session.
- KMS/HSM: We integrate with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault; BYOK import to customer HSM is supported for Private deployments and for snapshots via customer KMS where the provider allows import.
- 3-year audit logs: We can add extended audit retention as a contract add-on; we'll include pricing and export formats in the procurement packet.

Action items / MAP (updated):
- By 2026-10-10: Redwood to send the DPA blurb + redwood-region-options.pdf (attached) for Legal. (Owner: Ben)
- By 2026-10-12: Carewell to return any remaining questionnaire items. (Owner: Carewell Security)
- 2026-10-13 09:00 PST: Technical session scheduled (accept calendar invite from Priya). (Owner: Priya/Aisha)
- By 2026-10-20: Procurement to exchange draft commercial terms. (Owner: Procurement teams)

I'll attach the DPA blurb as a text file and the region options doc we discussed. If you need a signed attestation for the no-persist mode we'll route through Security to produce a short letter.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.
